Definition: from G1909 and G302; a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as:--when.
BiblicalUsage: Epan is 'when' — whenever, as soon as. When a stronger than he comes upon the strong man, he takes his armour in Luke 11:22, Herod says when you have found the child bring me word in Matthew 2:8, and when your eye is single your whole body is full of light in Luke 11:34.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe 'when' is the word of readiness — the stronger comes, the child is found, the eye is single, and the moment matters. I hold that God's 'when' is never late, and my job is to be ready for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
